modules.core: Dashboard CRUD — get all dashboards, find by ID or title, export, rename, move to folder, publish; resolve dashboard references.
modules.shares: Dashboard share management — add or update share entries for users and groups; retrieve current shares for a dashboard.
modules.columns: Column inspection — extract every distinct table/column reference used across widgets and filters in a dashboard.
modules.scripts: Dashboard and widget scripts — read and write JavaScript attached to a dashboard or to a specific widget within it.
